boundingBoxNote: Computed via THREE.Box3.setFromObject on the authored scene graph (world-space, post-transform) at build time, not from raw accessor min/max (which reflect local unit-geometry space for TRS-transformed nodes). Double C=O bonds are rendered as twin parallel cylinders, matching the 'Bond highlighting' interactive-component requirement.
